AttachmentPoint.name: Attachment Point
AttachmentPoint.definition: Indicates the lower point at which the level of losses in the underlying portfolio reduces the notional of the tranche.

DetachmentPoint.name: Detachment Point
DetachmentPoint.definition: Indicates the point beyond which the losses in the underlying portfolio no longer reduce the notional of the tranche.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one of the 2 elements must be present.
